bone-parchment.$description: Bone Parchment — Page canvas, large background areas, nav bar, secondary cards

paper-white.$description: Paper White — Elevated card surfaces, primary content surfaces above the canvas

soft-stone.$description: Soft Stone — Nested card surfaces, subtle background variation, alternate section bands

carbon-ink.$description: Carbon Ink — Primary text, headings, icon fills — warm near-black rather than pure black

graphite.$description: Graphite — Secondary headings, button text, nav text — softer than carbon

ashen.$description: Ashen — Muted helper text, captions, fine print, disclaimer copy

pebble.$description: Pebble — Tertiary text, copyright, very low-priority labels

mist.$description: Mist — Hairline nav dividers, subtle border lines

chalk.$description: Chalk — Decorative illustration fills, soft background tints

obsidian.$description: Obsidian — Footer background — only true black on the page

clay.$description: Clay — Orange decorative accent for icons, marks, and small graphic details. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

anthropic-serif.$description: Display and editorial headlines (Explore plans, Think fast build faster). The serif is the brand signature — rare in AI/tech product UI; here it signals thoughtfulness and editorial confidence rather than software utility.

anthropic-sans.$description: All interface text: body copy, nav, buttons, cards, links, labels. Weight 580 is the heaviest; weight 400 dominates. The whisper-to-medium weight range creates hierarchy through contrast rather than heaviness — headlines don't shout at 800, they speak at 580.
